name: EasyKara
desc: Sync lyrics word by word and export watermark-free karaoke MP4 videos at 60fps for free. Pro adds ASS/LRC/SRT downloads and desktop transparent video export.

hero.badge: Launch offer · 1 year Pro free for the first 100 users
hero.title: Turn any song into a karaoke video.
hero.subtitle: Sync lyrics word by word in your browser, then export a karaoke video or a subtitle file. No install needed — desktop apps available too.
hero.note: Windows · macOS (Apple silicon & Intel) · Linux · Web

features.title: Word-level sync
features.desc: Tap along to the beat to time every word of your lyrics.

features.title: Video export
features.desc: Render a ready-to-share karaoke video with highlighted lyrics.

features.title: Subtitle files
features.desc: Export .ass subtitles to use in your own video editor.

features.title: Many languages
features.desc: Interface in English, Vietnamese, Japanese, Korean and Chinese.

faqs.q: Do I need to install anything?
faqs.a: No. The web editor runs in your browser. Desktop apps are optional.

faqs.q: Which file formats can I export?
faqs.a: A karaoke video, or an .ass subtitle file for your own editor.
